output_list.code: function distribute(address[] _addresses, uint[] _amounts) public returns (bool success) {     require(_addresses.length < 256 && _addresses.length == _amounts.length);     uint totalAmount;     for (uint a = 0; a < _amounts.length; a++) {         totalAmount += _amounts[a];     }     require(totalAmount > 0 && balances[msg.sender] >= totalAmount);     balances[msg.sender] -= totalAmount;     for (uint b = 0; b < _addresses.length; b++) {         if (_amounts[b] > 0) {             balances[_addresses[b]] += _amounts[b];             Transfer(msg.sender, _addresses[b], _amounts[b]);         }     }     return true; }
output_list.reason: The distribute function has no restriction on how much MP3 Coin can be sent to each individual address specified. The user of this function will be able to distribute a large number of MP3 Coins to each individual. The resultant tokens may cause the totalSupply to exceed the maximum limit of totalSupply being 1000000 * 10 ** 8.
